dogecoin.text: The only "joke coins" out there are the ones minted by Joe Biden and friends, the public has spoken, we would rather have cute doggy money #dogecoin than anything the federal govt can print up.

I live in OR, @nbcsnl hasn't even started yet.  I wish there was an easy way to find out what jokes they made about #dogecoin.  Maybe I'll make a long distance call to my aunt who lives back east to find out. Hope she's not asleep yet.

Whenever I see a "crypto expert" on legacy media they make sure to point out #dogecoin is a joke that should be avoided, unlike all the other 'serious' digital coins. You know the ones with names like Pancake, Fudge Ripple and CryptoKitties.
